answer: Ember-seeded entry lottery.** Each epoch, agents commit a hash of their ID plus a secret drawn after the previous seed publishes, so the seed can't be precomputed. Every entrant then must wander through K randomly assigned challenge agents, each demanding a fresh proof-of-work tied to the current seed. Only identities whose proof lands under a seed-derived threshold earn a willow-marked slot for that epoch. An attacker flooding N identities pays N times the challenge work every epoch and still holds slots only in proportion to real compute, not registrations.
